rows.note: Use this for approximate numbers, amounts, times, or quantities.

example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 daai6 joek3 saam1 dim2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for being in the vicinity or spread throughout an area.

example.english: I'll walk around a bit first.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zau1 wai4 haang4 haa5 sin1

rows.note: Use this after a number or time to mean approximately that amount or point.

example.english: They said they would arrive around eight.
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 baat3 dim2 zo2 jau6 dou3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for moving from place to place or doing something in various places or with various people.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zau1 wai4 haang4 haa5 sin1

rows.note: Use this for something encircling an object, or for going around a perimeter when combined with a motion verb.

example.english: The children gathered around the teacher to listen to a story.
example.traditional: 啲小朋友圍住老師聽故事。
example.jyutping: di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 wai4 zyu6 lou5 si1 teng1 gu3 si6

rows.note: Use this when “around” introduces the topic or subject being discussed.

example.english: We were just talking about some issues around rent.
example.traditional: 我哋啱啱傾咗啲關於租金嘅問題。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ngaam1 ngaam1 king1 zo2 di1 gwaan1 jyu1 zou1 gam1 ge3 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this when people gather close together or surround someone or something, as in “gather around.”

example.english: The children gathered around to listen to a story.
example.traditional: 小朋友圍埋一齊聽故事。
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 wai4 maai4 jat1 cai4 teng1 gu3 si6

rows.note: Use this for turning back or reversing direction, especially at the end of a road.

example.english: Turn around when you reach the end of the road.
example.jyutping: heoi3 dou3 lou6 mei5 zau6 diu6 tau4
